acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you need permits for fall prevention modifications depends on the scope of the work and local building codes in Pacifica or Daly City. Minor installations like grab bars typically don't require permits. However, structural changes, significant plumbing or electrical work, or the construction of exterior ramps may require permits to ensure compliance with safety regulations. We will advise you on specific permit requirements during our initial assessment and assist with the application process if needed.
